title: CATACLYSM · BoRHeZ Games
prompt:
Apply evidence-grounded feedback from the recorded gameplay review. Preserve unrelated working behavior, controls and the stable URL.
Improve Cataclysm 0.4 game mechanics and gameplay balance based on detailed player feedback and QA findings.
acceptance: Enemies scale their movement speed or attack patterns to counterplayer movement speed upgrades, preventing infinite outrunning of fish.
Fish pickup mechanics are adjusted so fish do not disappear merely by outrunning; player is incentivized to collect fish despite movement speed.
Special projectile effects such as multi-shot and bouncing bullets have visually distinct, clear feedback (e.g., trails, impact flashes).
Add boss fights appearing at defined progression milestones (e.g., every 10 nights) to increase game challenge and engagement.
Introduce collectible items or power-ups beyond level-up menu to diversify build strategies and long-term progression.
UI displays additional information about score calculation and upgrade effects (tooltips or overlays) for better player understanding.
Balance upgrade choices so that movement speed, fire rate, and damage upgrades are each viable and strategically meaningful.
Verify that all HUD and control elements remain clear and functional during intense gameplay, especially with large enemy crowds.
